about_the_game:
"Rainy Day" is a block-puzzle game that blends rainy-day ambiance aesthetics. Players move unique blocks to solve intricate puzzles accompanied by the gentle patter of rainfall, with no time limits or penalties. Serene Zen-inspired mechanisms harmonize with white noise of dripping water, creating a meditative experience perfect for gloomy afternoons.

Important Note: The arrows on top of the block indicate the directions in which the block can move under the current state.
